beats.care: You will join huge crowds at festivals, concerts and matches. Knowing who must plan exits and limits helps you spot an unsafe venue.
beats.what: The Hindu wrote that the crush at Kolkata's Chorbagan Sarbojanin pandal, which killed 19 people, was a failure of planning.
beats.why: It was the first Durga Puja under Bengal's new BJP government, which wanted pandals to showcase religiosity. The paper says safety lagged.

cards.body: Heavy rain and lightning sent visitors rushing into a pandal with narrow gates and tight lanes. Fear about the structure caused panic. The paper says organisers and police did not plan for such a surge, and that temporary home guards were deployed where experienced police were needed.
cards.title: Beyond religiosity
cards.verdict: Big celebrations need capacity limits, safety checks before permission, clear exits and an independent inquiry, not action only after deaths.

cards.body: The editorial lists steps: estimate how many people will come, set a safe limit for each venue, inspect temporary structures and wiring before giving permission, keep emergency lanes clear, and use CCTV and announcements to spot crowding early.
cards.title: what should change before the next festival?

a.body: Officials and organisers failed to plan for crowds and weather. The state's focus on showcasing religiosity must not come at the cost of public safety.
a.label: The Hindu says

b.body: The CM said he would seek a court-backed fact-finding team. Kolkata Police cancelled VIP passes and set new crowd rules after the crush.
b.label: The state government says

cards.note: Seven people were arrested in the days after the crush, police said.
cards.title: Who carries the blame?

cards.q: What would most prevent such crushes?

opts: Safety planning must come before grandeur
cards.q: What is the editorial's main argument?
cards.why: The paper says big festivals are fine, but crowd limits, exits and trained staff must be planned before the crowds arrive.

hook: 19 died at a pandal. Is a festival's *grandeur* coming before safety?

learn.t: Crowd crushes often start with a sudden trigger like rain. The editorial says each venue needs a safe capacity limit set beforehand.

watch: The CM said he would seek a fact-finding team through the Calcutta High Court. Watch what it finds about permissions and policing.
